name.description: Its own name, as the folder of a plain clone bears it: one line of 1 to 100 characters, with no slash, backslash or colon.

description.description: What of the system lies in it, in 1 to 2,000 characters: the code of which parts, the deploy files, the documents.

url.description: Where it is cloned from: one line of 1 to 200 characters with no space, begun with `https://`, `http://`, `ssh://` or `git://`, or of the form `git@host:path`. Never a path on a disk.

workspace.description: `true`: on every machine its checkout lies beside the model's folder, in a folder of its `name`, as a workspace's clone script puts it. Read it there, and search it by naming that folder: a search begun above it skips a folder that an ignore file names. Left out when its place differs from one machine to the next: then it is one of the folders the session can read, or it is not in reach, and a skill says so.

description: A repository that holds code or deploy files of the system, other than the one the model's folder lies in: that one needs no record. A system or an app whose code is in it names it with `repository`; one that holds only deploy files or documents is named by none. It says which repository to read, and never where a checkout lies on a machine: no path, and no folder inside it. Written from a file that names the repository, as a clone script, a workspace's manifest or a package's own `repository`, or from a person's word; never from an image's name.
